description: Reface Frame Diagnostics & Benchmark Test Set Manifest across diverse motion, occlusion, and lighting scenarios

ground_truth_states.present_processable: Target face is clearly in frame, unoccluded or lightly occluded, and valid for swapping
ground_truth_states.occluded: Target face is heavily covered (> 70%) by hand, hair, glass, or object
ground_truth_states.out_of_frame: Target person is physically outside camera field of view
ground_truth_states.uncertain: Extreme motion blur, sensor noise, or ambiguous identity where ground truth cannot be established

failure_taxonomy.description: Face detector produced no bounding box or landmarks in target ROI
Detection rejected by identity verification against source model
Kalman / IoU / optical tracking lost continuity across consecutive frames
Landmark configuration degenerate, collapsed, or out of frame bounds
Swapper or DFM neural network raised runtime error or produced null
Segmentation mask empty, corrupted, or inverted
Output face region pixel delta below UNCHANGED_FACE_MAD threshold
Face height below MIN_FACE_PX gate (40px) or unrecoverably degraded

scenarios.name: frontal_speech
scenarios.description: Frontal angle, natural indoor lighting, active mouth movement and speech articulation

scenarios.name: profile_turn
scenarios.description: Continuous head turn from frontal (0 deg) to sharp profile (> 60 deg yaw) and return

scenarios.name: fast_motion
scenarios.description: Rapid translation, head nodding and whip pan creating directional motion blur

scenarios.name: variable_lighting
scenarios.description: Subject moving from direct sunbeam into shadow with dramatic color temperature shift

scenarios.name: small_face
scenarios.description: Full-body and upper-body wide framing where face is 40-70px in 1080p frame

scenarios.name: occlusion_hand_glasses
scenarios.description: Hand entering frame, touching chin, rubbing eye; glasses frame and temple arms

scenarios.name: multi_person_cross
scenarios.description: Two individuals walking past each other with overlapping bounding boxes and camera crossover

scenarios.name: exit_and_reentry
scenarios.description: Target person walks completely out of frame for 25 frames and re-enters from opposite side

scenarios.name: scene_cut
scenarios.description: Two distinct camera shots joined by an instantaneous hard cut without cross-fade

identity_splits.policy: Strict isolation between build source images and held-out evaluation references using perceptual dHash grouping to eliminate identical or burst shots
identity_splits.independent_judge: antelopev2 glintr100 (ONNX), strictly distinct from buffalo_l w600k used by swappers
